scripts.dev: pnpm db:up && pnpm --filter "./packages/*" build && pnpm run --workspace-concurrency=16 "/^dev:/"
scripts.lint:cfn: cfn-lint cloudformation/main.yaml cloudformation/stacks/*.yaml cloudformation/bootstrap/*.yaml && python3 cloudformation/scripts/check_nested.py && pnpm guard:cfn
scripts.guard:cfn: cfn-guard test --rules-file cloudformation/guard/joybot.guard --test-data cloudformation/guard/tests/joybot_tests.yaml >/dev/null && cfn-guard validate --rules cloudformation/guard --data cloudformation/main.yaml --data cloudformation/stacks --data cloudformation/bootstrap --show-summary fail
